147	    async def wait_idle(self) -> None:
148	        """Wait for every running turn (shutdown, tests)."""
149	        while pending := [t for t in self._tasks if not t.done()]:
150	            await asyncio.wait(pending)
151	
152	    async def _events(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
153	        while True:
154	            try:
155	                event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), self.ping_interval)
156	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
157	                yield Event("ping", {})
158	                continue
159	            if event is None:
160	                return
161	            yield event
162	
163	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one turn -----------
164	    async def _run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
165	                   queue: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
166	        def emit(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
167	            queue.put_nowait(Event(name, data))
168	
169	        try:
170	            async with self._locks.hold_async(conversation_id, timeout=self.lock_timeout):
171	                await self._turn(user_id, conversation_id, text, reasoning_effort, emit)
172	        except ConversationBusy:
173	            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": BUSY})
174	        except Exception:
175	            log.exception("chat turn failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
176	            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
177	        finally:
178	            queue.put_nowait(None)
179	
180	    async def _turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
181	                    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]) -> None:
182	        store = self.store
183	        conversation = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_conversation, user_id, conversation_id)
184	        user_message = await asyncio.to_thread(store.add_message, user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
185	        emit("user_message", message_view(user_message))
186	        if conversation is not None and not conversation["title"]:
187	            await asyncio.to_thread(store.set_conversation_title, user_id, conversation_id,
188	                                    " ".join(text.split())[:TITLE_CHARS])
189	
190	        context = await asyncio.to_thread(build_context, store, user_id, conversation_id)
191	        index = await asyncio.to_thread(self._city_index)
192	        today = store.clock().date()
193	        guard = ReplyGuard(index, records=context.records, user_text=text,
194	                           earlier_user_texts=context.user_texts[:-1], today=today)
195	        turn = _Turn(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, guard, emit, BudgetTracker(self.budget),
196	                     reasoning_effort)
197	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt(today)}, *context.messages]
198	
199	        try:
200	            async with asyncio.timeout(self.turn_timeout):
201	                fallback = await self._steps(turn, messages)
202	        except TimeoutError:
203	            fallback = [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": str(self.turn_timeout)}]
204	        except LLMError as exc:
205	            fallback = [{"kind": "llm_error", "value": str(exc)[:200]}]
206	        except Exception as exc:  # a bug or a store error in the middle of the turn
207	            if not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
208	                raise
209	            log.exception("chat turn failed after producing output (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
210	            fallback = [{"kind": "internal_error", "value": type(exc).__name__}]
211	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("max_steps", "token_budget", "tool_budget"):
212	            log.warning("chat turn stopped by its budget (conversation %s): %s %s", conversation_id,
213	                        fallback[0]["kind"], turn.budget.snapshot())
214	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("llm_error", "turn_timeout") \
215	                and not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
216	            emit("error", {"code": "llm_unavailable", "message": LLM_UNAVAILABLE})
217	            return
218	        await self._finish(turn, fallback)
219	
220	    async def _steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
221	        """The LLM / tool steps of a turn. Returns None when the LLM's text can stay, otherwise
222	        the problems that make the template reply replace it.
223	
224	        Budgets (design §4.8): a step starts only while steps and tokens are left; each tool call
225	        runs only while calls are left for the step and the turn. A call that is not admitted is
226	        never executed: it gets a `tool_budget_exceeded` result (stored like any tool call, so
227	        every tool call of the completion has its result and the stored history stays well-formed).
228	        Once the turn's calls are used up and a call was refused, the turn ends with the template."""
229	        while (stop := turn.budget.stop_before_step()) is None:
230	            try:
231	                completion = await self._llm_step(turn, messages)
232	            except _GuardFailed as failed:
233	                return failed.problems
234	            if not completion.tool_calls:
235	                if completion.finish_reason != "stop":  # "length", "content_filter", ...
236	                    return [{"kind": "truncated", "value": str(completion.finish_reason)}]
237	                if not turn.text.strip():
238	                    return [{"kind": "empty_reply", "value": ""}]
239	                return None
240	            messages.append(completion.assistant_message())
241	            turn_exhausted = False
242	            for call in completion.tool_calls:
243	                refused = turn.budget.admit_tool_call()
244	                if refused is None:
245	                    turn.emit("status", {"text": STATUS_TEXT.get(call["name"], DEFAULT_STATUS)})
246	                    outcome = await asyncio.to_thread(self._tools.run, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id,
247	                                                      call["name"], call["arguments"])
248	                else:
249	                    turn_exhausted = turn_exhausted or refused == "per_turn"
250	                    payload = refusal(refused, self.budget)
251	                    outcome = Outcome(call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], payload["code"], payload,
252	                                      error=f"budget: {refused}")
253	                await asyncio.to_thread(
254	                    self.store.add_tool_call, turn.user_id, turn.user_message["id"], outcome.name,
255	                    outcome.args, outcome.payload, error=outcome.error, latency_ms=outcome.latency_ms)
256	                turn.outcomes.append(outcome)
257	                if refused is None:  # a refusal is no record a reply may quote
258	                    turn.guard.add_record(outcome.payload)
259	                for card in outcome.cards:
260	                    turn.cards.append(card)
261	                    turn.emit("card", {"card": card})
262	                messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": outcome.for_llm()})
263	            if turn_exhausted:
264	                return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(self.budget.max_tool_calls_per_turn)}]
265	        return [stop]
266	
267	    async def _finish(self, turn: _Turn, fallback: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
268	        """Persist the assistant message (the `done` moment: quote cards become bookable)."""
269	        text = turn.text.rstrip()
270	        if fallback is not None:
271	            text = fallback_reply(turn.outcomes)
272	            turn.emit("replace", {"text": text})
273	        elif CLICK_TO_BOOK not in text and any(
274	                o.name == "request_booking" and o.code == "ok" for o in turn.outcomes):
275	            # fixed by code, whatever the LLM wrote: the click is what books
276	            piece = ("\n\n" if text else "") + CLICK_TO_BOOK
277	            turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
278	            text += piece
279	        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
280	            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, text, turn.cards, fallback)
281	        turn.emit("done", {"message": message})
282	
283	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ LLM step -----------
284	    def _release(self, turn: _Turn, piece: str, first_of_step: bool) -> None:
285	        """Check the reply so far plus `piece`; send `piece` when nothing is wrong. Checking the
286	        whole text catches a number or a city name that spans two pieces (`St. | Louis`)."""
287	        if not turn.text:
288	            piece = piece.lstrip()
289	        elif first_of_step and not turn.text[-1].isspace() and not piece[:1].isspace():
290	            piece = "\n\n" + piece  # text of a later step starts a new paragraph
291	        problems = turn.guard.check(turn.text + piece)
292	        if problems:
293	            raise _GuardFailed(problems)
294	        turn.text += piece
295	        turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
296	
297	    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> Completion:
298	        """One LLM call with retries. Text is released as it streams. A failed call is retried
299	        only while none of its text has been released."""
300	        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),
301	                   "tools": [t["function"]["name"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS],
302	                   "reasoning_effort": turn.reasoning_effort or getattr(self.llm, "reasoning_effort", None)}
303	        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
304	            started = time.monotonic()
305	            buffer = SentenceBuffer()
306	            completion: Completion | None = None
307	            released = False
308	            content = blank = ""
309	
310	            def log_call(response: dict, tokens: int | None = None, usage: Any = None) -> Awaitable[Any]:
311	                # every attempt counts against the turn's tokens, also failed ones and retries
312	                charged, estimated = turn.budget.charge(usage, messages)
313	                response = {**response, "budget": {"charged_tokens": charged, "estimated": estimated,
314	                                                   "turn_tokens": turn.budget.tokens}}
315	                return asyncio.to_thread(
316	                    self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
317	                    latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=tokens,
318	                    model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))
319	
320	            try:
321	                # aclosing: a guard failure or a timeout must close the HTTP stream right away
322	                async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout), \
323	                        aclosing(self.llm.stream(
324	                            messages, TOOL_SCHEMAS, reasoning_effort=turn.reasoning_effort)) as stream:
325	                    async for event in stream:
326	                        if isinstance(event, TextDelta):
327	                            content += event.text
328	                            for sentence in buffer.push(event.text):
329	                                if sentence.strip():
330	                                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
331	                                    blank, released = "", True
332	                                else:
333	                                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own
334	                        else:
335	                            completion = event
336	                if completion is None:
337	                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a completion", retryable=True)
338	                rest = buffer.flush()
339	                if rest.strip():
340	                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
341	            except _GuardFailed as failed:
342	                await log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems, "aborted": True})
343	                raise
344	            except (LLMError, TimeoutError) as exc:
345	                error = exc if isinstance(exc, LLMError) else LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True)
346	                await log_call({"content": content, "error": str(error)[:300], "attempt": attempt + 1})
347	                if released or not error.retryable or attempt == self.retries:
348	                    raise error from None
349	                await self._sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
350	                continue
351	            await log_call(completion.as_record(), completion.total_tokens, completion.usage)
352	            return completion
353	        raise LLMError("unreachable", retryable=False)  # pragma: no cover
354	
355	    def _city_index(self) -> CityIndex:
356	        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when
357	        locations.db changes)."""
358	        net = self._networks.current()
359	        if self._index is None or self._index[0] != net.fingerprint.id:
360	            self._index = (net.fingerprint.id, CityIndex(net.cities))
361	        return self._index[1]
362	"""The four tools the LLM can call: schemas, argument validation, dispatch to the airline.
363	
364	Arguments are names and ids only - never a distance or a price - so the LLM cannot pass a number
365	it made up. Results go back to the LLM as display values; errors are structured records too.
366	
367	There is no booking tool. `Toolbox` keeps only the four bound methods it dispatches to, not the
368	`Airline` object, so nothing in this module can reach `Airline.book` (design P4, rule M04).
369	"""
370	from __future__ import annotations
371	
372	import json
373	import time
374	from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
375	from typing import Any, Callable
376	
377	MAX_ARG_CHARS = 200
378	MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS = 2000  # the whole JSON of one call
379	MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM = 20  # the card lists them all; `count` is always the full number
380	
381	
382	def _tool(name: str, description: str, properties: dict[str, str], required: list[str]) -> dict:
383	    return {
384	        "type": "function",
385	        "function": {
386	            "name": name,
387	            "description": description,
388	            "parameters": {
389	                "type": "object",
390	                "properties": {k: {"type": "string", "description": v} for k, v in properties.items()},
391	                "required": required,
392	                "additionalProperties": False,
393	            },
394	        },
395	    }
396	
397	
398	TOOL_SCHEMAS = [
399	    _tool("find_city",
400	          "Look up one city: whether Ocean Above flies there, and if not, the nearest cities that "
401	          "have service. Use it when the user asks about a single city.",
402	          {"name": "City name as the user wrote it."}, ["name"]),
403	    _tool("quote_route",
404	          "Find the cheapest route between two cities and create a quote (legs, transfer cities, "
405	          "distance, price). Also reports unknown, ambiguous or unserved cities, with the nearest "
406	          "served cities. Shows a route card to the user.",
407	          {"origin": "Departure city as the user wrote it.",
408	           "destination": "Arrival city as the user wrote it."},
409	          ["origin", "destination"]),
410	    _tool("request_booking",
411	          "Show the user a confirmation card for an existing quote. Call it when the user wants to "
412	          "book a quoted route. It does NOT book: the ticket is issued only when the user clicks "
413	          "Confirm booking on the card.",
414	          {"quote_id": "The quote_id from a quote_route result (starts with q_)."}, ["quote_id"]),
415	    _tool("list_my_tickets",
416	          "List the tickets the user has booked, with the count. All filters are optional.",
417	          {"city": "Only tickets whose origin, destination or a transfer is this city.",
418	           "ticket_id": "Only this ticket (starts with t_).",
419	           "booked_after": "ISO date or datetime (UTC); tickets booked at or after it.",
420	           "booked_before": "ISO date or datetime (UTC); tickets booked before it."},
421	          []),
422	]
423	STATUS_TEXT = {
424	    "find_city": "Looking up the city…",
425	    "quote_route": "Looking up routes…",
426	    "request_booking": "Preparing your confirmation…",
427	    "list_my_tickets": "Looking up your tickets…",
428	}
429	DEFAULT_STATUS = "Working on it…"
430	_SPECS = {t["function"]["name"]: t["function"]["parameters"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS}
431	
432	
433	@dataclass(frozen=True)
434	class Outcome:
435	    """One executed (or refused) tool call."""
436	
437	    name: str
438	    args: Any  # parsed arguments, or the raw string when they were not valid JSON
439	    code: str
440	    payload: dict  # the JSON the LLM gets: {"code": ..., display values, names, ids}
441	    cards: tuple[dict, ...] = ()
442	    error: str | None = None  # set for calls that did not run or crashed
443	    latency_ms: int = 0
444	
445	    def for_llm(self) -> str:
446	        return json.dumps(self.payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
447	
448	
449	def slim(value: Any) -> Any:
450	    """Drop the 30-decimal `distance` / `price` strings where a display value sits next to them:
451	    the LLM only ever sees display values."""
452	    if isinstance(value, dict):
453	        return {k: slim(v) for k, v in value.items()
454	                if not (k in ("distance", "price") and f"{k}_display" in value)}
455	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
456	        return [slim(v) for v in value]
457	    return value
458	
459	
460	def _payload(code: str, data: dict) -> dict:
461	    out = {"code": code, **slim(data)}
462	    if isinstance(out.get("tickets"), list) and len(out["tickets"]) > MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM:
463	        out["tickets"] = out["tickets"][:MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM]  # newest first
464	        out["tickets_shown"] = MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM
465	    if isinstance(out.get("legs"), list) and isinstance(out.get("transfers"), list):
466	        # counted here so the LLM never counts (FSR: self-reported counts go wrong)
467	        out["leg_count"] = len(out["legs"])
468	        out["transfer_count"] = len(out["transfers"])
469	    return out
470	
471	
472	def validate(name: str, args: Any) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
473	    """(clean arguments, None) or (None, what is wrong)."""
474	    spec = _SPECS[name]
475	    if not isinstance(args, dict):
476	        return None, "arguments must be a JSON object"
477	    unknown = sorted(set(args) - set(spec["properties"]))
478	    if unknown:
479	        return None, f"unknown argument(s): {', '.join(unknown)}; allowed: {', '.join(spec['properties'])}"
480	    clean: dict[str, str] = {}
481	    for key in spec["properties"]:
482	        value = args.get(key)
483	        if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip() and key not in spec["required"]):
484	            continue
485	        if not isinstance(value, str):
486	            return None, f"{key} must be a string"
487	        value = value.strip()
488	        if not value:
489	            return None, f"{key} must not be empty"
490	        if len(value) > MAX_ARG_CHARS:
491	            return None, f"{key} is too long"
492	        clean[key] = value
493	    missing = [k for k in spec["required"] if k not in clean]
494	    if missing:
495	        return None, f"missing argument(s): {', '.join(missing)}"
496	    return clean, None
497	
498	
499	class Toolbox:
500	    def __init__(self, airline: Any):
501	        find_city, quote_route = airline.find_city, airline.quote_route
502	        request_booking, list_tickets = airline.request_booking, airline.list_tickets
503	        self._run: dict[str, Callable[[str, str, dict], Any]] = {
504	            "find_city": lambda user, conv, a: find_city(a["name"]),
505	            "quote_route": lambda user, conv, a: quote_route(user, conv, a["origin"], a["destination"]),
506	            "request_booking": lambda user, conv, a: request_booking(user, conv, a["quote_id"]),
507	            "list_my_tickets": lambda user, conv, a: list_tickets(user, **a),
508	        }
509	
510	    def run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, name: str, raw_arguments: str) -> Outcome:
511	        """Validate and execute one tool call. Never raises: every failure is an Outcome the LLM
512	        can read and correct."""
513	        started = time.monotonic()
514	
515	        def refused(code: str, message: str, args: Any, **extra: Any) -> Outcome:
516	            return Outcome(name, args, code, {"code": code, "message": message, **extra},
517	                           error=message, latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
518	
519	        if name not in self._run:
520	            return refused("unknown_tool", f"there is no tool named {name!r}", raw_arguments,
521	                           available=sorted(self._run))
522	        if not isinstance(raw_arguments, str):
523	            raw_arguments = ""
524	        if len(raw_arguments) > MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS:
525	            return refused("invalid_arguments", "arguments are too long", raw_arguments[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS])
526	        try:
527	            args = json.loads(raw_arguments) if raw_arguments.strip() else {}
528	        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
529	            return refused("invalid_arguments", "arguments are not valid JSON", raw_arguments)
530	        clean, problem = validate(name, args)
531	        if clean is None:
532	            return refused("invalid_arguments", problem or "invalid arguments", args)
533	        try:
534	            result = self._run[name](user_id, conversation_id, clean)
535	        except Exception as exc:  # NetworkDataError (locations.db unreadable), NotFound, bugs
536	            failed = refused("tool_failed", "the tool could not run; flight data may be unavailable", clean)
537	            return replace(failed, error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:500])
538	        return Outcome(name, clean, result.code, _payload(result.code, result.data),
539	                       tuple(result.cards), latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
540	
541	"""LLM settings from the environment. The key is read here and nowhere else; it is never logged
542	and never part of a repr."""
543	from __future__ import annotations
544	
545	import os
546	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
547	from pathlib import Path
548	from typing import Mapping
549	
550	DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.deepseek.com"
551	# DeepSeek's flash model id on 2026-11-23 (GET /models: "deepseek-flash" = DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash).
552	DEFAULT_MODEL = "deepseek-flash"
553	REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
554	EFFORTS = ("none", "low", "high", "max")  # what a request may ask for
555	
556	
557	class LLMNotConfigured(Exception):
558	    """No API key in the environment or the env file."""
559	
560	
561	def read_env_file(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, str]:
562	    """KEY=VALUE lines of a .env file (comments, blank lines and `export ` are skipped)."""
563	    out: dict[str, str] = {}
564	    try:
565	        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
566	    except OSError:
567	        return out
568	    for line in text.splitlines():
569	        line = line.strip()
570	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
571	            continue
572	        key, value = line.removeprefix("export ").split("=", 1)
573	        value = value.strip()
574	        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "'\"":
575	            value = value[1:-1]
576	        out[key.strip()] = value
577	    return out
578	
579	
580	@dataclass(frozen=True)
581	class LLMConfig:
582	    api_key: str = field(repr=False)
583	    base_url: str = DEFAULT_BASE_URL
584	    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
585	    # Thinking level (DeepSeek: `thinking` + `reasoning_effort`, docs "Thinking Mode"):
586	    #   "low" | "high" | "max" -> {"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}, "reasoning_effort": <level>}
587	    #   "none"                 -> {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}
588	    #   "omit"                 -> neither field, for OpenAI-compatible servers that reject them
589	    reasoning_effort: str = "high"
590	
591	    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
592	        if self.reasoning_effort not in (*EFFORTS, "omit"):
593	            raise ValueError(f"LLM_REASONING_EFFORT must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)} or omit")
594	
595	    @classmethod
596	    def from_env(cls, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> "LLMConfig":
597	        """`LLM_API_KEY` (fallback `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), `LLM_BASE_URL`, `LLM_MODEL`,
598	        `LLM_REASONING_EFFORT` (default high). Process environment first; then the file named by `OCEAN_ENV_FILE`
599	        (default: `.env` in the repository root), so a worktree can point at the main checkout."""
600	        env = os.environ if env is None else env
601	        file_values = read_env_file(env.get("OCEAN_ENV_FILE") or REPO_ROOT / ".env")
602	
603	        def get(name: str) -> str:
604	            return (env.get(name) or file_values.get(name) or "").strip()
605	
606	        key = get("LLM_API_KEY") or get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
607	        if not key:
608	            raise LLMNotConfigured("set LLM_API_KEY (or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), or OCEAN_ENV_FILE")
609	        return cls(
610	            api_key=key,
611	            base_url=(get("LLM_BASE_URL") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL).rstrip("/"),
612	            model=get("LLM_MODEL") or DEFAULT_MODEL,
613	            reasoning_effort=(get("LLM_REASONING_EFFORT") or "high").lower(),
614	        )

"""The agent loop (design §4): one chat turn as a stream of contract SSE events.

    user message stored -> [LLM -> tools -> cards]* -> guarded text -> assistant message stored

The LLM chooses tools and writes text; routes, prices and tickets come from the airline through
the four tools. Text is released sentence by sentence after the ReplyGuard traced every number
and city in it; the first problem replaces the whole reply with a code template. The turn's
quote cards become bookable only when `Airline.post_assistant_message` stores them (`done`).

Nothing here can book: the loop talks to the airline through `Toolbox` (four tools, no booking)
and `post_assistant_message`. Booking is the HTTP endpoint's call, caused by the user's click.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
import time
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable

from ..airline import ConversationBusy, NotFound
from .budget import AgentBudget, BudgetTracker, refusal
from .context import build_context
from .guard import CityIndex, ReplyGuard, SentenceBuffer
from .config import EFFORTS
from .llm import LLM, Completion, LLMError, TextDelta
from .prompt import system_prompt
from .templates import CLICK_TO_BOOK, fallback_reply
from .tools import DEFAULT_STATUS, STATUS_TEXT, TOOL_SCHEMAS, MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS, Outcome, Toolbox

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_BUDGET = AgentBudget()
MAX_STEPS = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_steps
TURN_TIMEOUT = DEFAULT_BUDGET.max_turn_seconds  # a whole turn (all LLM calls, tools, retries); then the template reply
LOCK_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # waiting for another turn of the same conversation; then conversation_busy
MAX_USER_CHARS = 2000
TITLE_CHARS = 60
LLM_UNAVAILABLE = "The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Your message was saved; please try again."
BUSY = "This conversation is still working on your previous message. Please try again in a moment."
INTERNAL = "Something went wrong. Your message was saved; please try again."


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Event:
    """One SSE event of docs/api/contract.md: `name` and its JSON `data`."""

    name: str
    data: dict


class _GuardFailed(Exception):
    def __init__(self, problems: list[dict]):
        super().__init__("reply guard")
        self.problems = problems


@dataclass
class _Turn:
    user_id: str
    conversation_id: str
    user_message: dict
    guard: ReplyGuard
    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]
    budget: BudgetTracker = field(default_factory=lambda: BudgetTracker(DEFAULT_BUDGET))
    reasoning_effort: str | None = None  # per-request thinking level; None = the client's default
    text: str = ""  # released so far
    cards: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    outcomes: list[Outcome] = field(default_factory=list)


def message_view(message: dict) -> dict:
    """Contract `Message` of a stored row without quote cards (user messages)."""
    return {"id": message["id"], "role": message["role"], "text": message["text"],
            "cards": list(message["cards"]), "created_at": message["created_at"]}


class Agent:
    def __init__(self, airline: Any, llm: LLM, *, budget: AgentBudget | None = None,
                 max_steps: int | None = None,
                 ping_interval: float = 15.0, retries: int = 2, backoff: float = 0.5,
                 llm_timeout: float = 60.0, turn_timeout: float | None = None,
                 lock_timeout: float | None = LOCK_TIMEOUT,
                 sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None]] = asyncio.sleep):
        """`budget`: the per-turn limits (design §4.8; default `AgentBudget()`). `max_steps` and
        `turn_timeout` override its fields (tests, older callers)."""
        budget = budget or DEFAULT_BUDGET
        if max_steps is not None:
            budget = replace(budget, max_steps=max_steps)
        if turn_timeout is not None:
            budget = replace(budget, max_turn_seconds=turn_timeout)
        self.budget = budget
        self.llm = llm
        self.store = airline.store
        self.ping_interval = ping_interval
        self.retries = retries
        self.backoff = backoff
        self.llm_timeout = llm_timeout
        self.lock_timeout = lock_timeout
        self._sleep = sleep
        self._tools = Toolbox(airline)
        # The only other things the loop takes from the airline. No reference to the Airline
        # object itself is kept.
        self._post_assistant_message = airline.post_assistant_message
        self._locks = airline.locks
        self._networks = airline.networks
        self._index: tuple[str, CityIndex] | None = None
        self._tasks: set[asyncio.Task] = set()

    @property
    def max_steps(self) -> int:
        return self.budget.max_steps

    @property
    def turn_timeout(self) -> float:
        return self.budget.max_turn_seconds

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ public -------------
    def stream_turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, *,
                    reasoning_effort: str | None = None) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
        """Start a turn and return its events: `user_message`, then `status` / `card` / `delta` /
        `replace` / `ping`, ending with exactly one `done` or `error`.

        `reasoning_effort` overrides the LLM's thinking level for this turn (none / low / high /
        max; None = configured default).

        Raises before anything is stored: NotFound (not the user's conversation), ValueError
        (empty or too long text, unknown reasoning_effort). Must be called on the event loop. The turn runs in its own
        task: it finishes and is stored even when the client stops reading."""
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
            raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
        text = text.strip()
        if len(text) > MAX_USER_CHARS:
            raise ValueError(f"text is longer than {MAX_USER_CHARS} characters")
        if reasoning_effort is not None and reasoning_effort not in EFFORTS:
            raise ValueError(f"reasoning_effort must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)}")
        if self.store.get_conversation(user_id, conversation_id) is None:
            raise NotFound(conversation_id)
        queue: asyncio.Queue[Event | None] = asyncio.Queue()
        task = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(
            self._run(user_id, conversation_id, text, reasoning_effort, queue))
        self._tasks.add(task)
        task.add_done_callback(self._tasks.discard)
        return self._events(queue)

    async def wait_idle(self) -> None:
        """Wait for every running turn (shutdown, tests)."""
        while pending := [t for t in self._tasks if not t.done()]:
            await asyncio.wait(pending)

    async def _events(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
        while True:
            try:
                event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), self.ping_interval)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                yield Event("ping", {})
                continue
            if event is None:
                return
            yield event

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one turn -----------
    async def _run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
                   queue: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
        def emit(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
            queue.put_nowait(Event(name, data))

        try:
            async with self._locks.hold_async(conversation_id, timeout=self.lock_timeout):
                await self._turn(user_id, conversation_id, text, reasoning_effort, emit)
        except ConversationBusy:
            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": BUSY})
        except Exception:
            log.exception("chat turn failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
        finally:
            queue.put_nowait(None)

    async def _turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
                    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]) -> None:
        store = self.store
        conversation = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_conversation, user_id, conversation_id)
        user_message = await asyncio.to_thread(store.add_message, user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
        emit("user_message", message_view(user_message))
        if conversation is not None and not conversation["title"]:
            await asyncio.to_thread(store.set_conversation_title, user_id, conversation_id,
                                    " ".join(text.split())[:TITLE_CHARS])

        context = await asyncio.to_thread(build_context, store, user_id, conversation_id)
        index = await asyncio.to_thread(self._city_index)
        today = store.clock().date()
        guard = ReplyGuard(index, records=context.records, user_text=text,
                           earlier_user_texts=context.user_texts[:-1], today=today)
        turn = _Turn(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, guard, emit, BudgetTracker(self.budget),
                     reasoning_effort)
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt(today)}, *context.messages]

        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.turn_timeout):
                fallback = await self._steps(turn, messages)
        except TimeoutError:
            fallback = [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": str(self.turn_timeout)}]
        except LLMError as exc:
            fallback = [{"kind": "llm_error", "value": str(exc)[:200]}]
        except Exception as exc:  # a bug or a store error in the middle of the turn
            if not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
                raise
            log.exception("chat turn failed after producing output (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
            fallback = [{"kind": "internal_error", "value": type(exc).__name__}]
        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("max_steps", "token_budget", "tool_budget"):
            log.warning("chat turn stopped by its budget (conversation %s): %s %s", conversation_id,
                        fallback[0]["kind"], turn.budget.snapshot())
        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("llm_error", "turn_timeout") \
                and not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
            emit("error", {"code": "llm_unavailable", "message": LLM_UNAVAILABLE})
            return
        await self._finish(turn, fallback)

    async def _steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
        """The LLM / tool steps of a turn. Returns None when the LLM's text can stay, otherwise
        the problems that make the template reply replace it.

        Budgets (design §4.8): a step starts only while steps and tokens are left; each tool call
        runs only while calls are left for the step and the turn. A call that is not admitted is
        never executed: it gets a `tool_budget_exceeded` result (stored like any tool call, so
        every tool call of the completion has its result and the stored history stays well-formed).
        Once the turn's calls are used up and a call was refused, the turn ends with the template."""
        while (stop := turn.budget.stop_before_step()) is None:
            try:
                completion = await self._llm_step(turn, messages)
            except _GuardFailed as failed:
                return failed.problems
            if not completion.tool_calls:
                if completion.finish_reason != "stop":  # "length", "content_filter", ...
                    return [{"kind": "truncated", "value": str(completion.finish_reason)}]
                if not turn.text.strip():
                    return [{"kind": "empty_reply", "value": ""}]
                return None
            messages.append(completion.assistant_message())
            turn_exhausted = False
            for call in completion.tool_calls:
                refused = turn.budget.admit_tool_call()
                if refused is None:
                    turn.emit("status", {"text": STATUS_TEXT.get(call["name"], DEFAULT_STATUS)})
                    outcome = await asyncio.to_thread(self._tools.run, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id,
                                                      call["name"], call["arguments"])
                else:
                    turn_exhausted = turn_exhausted or refused == "per_turn"
                    payload = refusal(refused, self.budget)
                    outcome = Outcome(call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], payload["code"], payload,
                                      error=f"budget: {refused}")
                await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.store.add_tool_call, turn.user_id, turn.user_message["id"], outcome.name,
                    outcome.args, outcome.payload, error=outcome.error, latency_ms=outcome.latency_ms)
                turn.outcomes.append(outcome)
                if refused is None:  # a refusal is no record a reply may quote
                    turn.guard.add_record(outcome.payload)
                for card in outcome.cards:
                    turn.cards.append(card)
                    turn.emit("card", {"card": card})
                messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": outcome.for_llm()})
            if turn_exhausted:
                return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(self.budget.max_tool_calls_per_turn)}]
        return [stop]

    async def _finish(self, turn: _Turn, fallback: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
        """Persist the assistant message (the `done` moment: quote cards become bookable)."""
        text = turn.text.rstrip()
        if fallback is not None:
            text = fallback_reply(turn.outcomes)
            turn.emit("replace", {"text": text})
        elif CLICK_TO_BOOK not in text and any(
                o.name == "request_booking" and o.code == "ok" for o in turn.outcomes):
            # fixed by code, whatever the LLM wrote: the click is what books
            piece = ("\n\n" if text else "") + CLICK_TO_BOOK
            turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
            text += piece
        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, text, turn.cards, fallback)
        turn.emit("done", {"message": message})

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ LLM step -----------
    def _release(self, turn: _Turn, piece: str, first_of_step: bool) -> None:
        """Check the reply so far plus `piece`; send `piece` when nothing is wrong. Checking the
        whole text catches a number or a city name that spans two pieces (`St. | Louis`)."""
        if not turn.text:
            piece = piece.lstrip()
        elif first_of_step and not turn.text[-1].isspace() and not piece[:1].isspace():
            piece = "\n\n" + piece  # text of a later step starts a new paragraph
        problems = turn.guard.check(turn.text + piece)
        if problems:
            raise _GuardFailed(problems)
        turn.text += piece
        turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})

    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> Completion:
        """One LLM call with retries. Text is released as it streams. A failed call is retried
        only while none of its text has been released."""
        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),
                   "tools": [t["function"]["name"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS],
                   "reasoning_effort": turn.reasoning_effort or getattr(self.llm, "reasoning_effort", None)}
        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
            started = time.monotonic()
            buffer = SentenceBuffer()
            completion: Completion | None = None
            released = False
            content = blank = ""

            def log_call(response: dict, tokens: int | None = None, usage: Any = None) -> Awaitable[Any]:
                # every attempt counts against the turn's tokens, also failed ones and retries
                charged, estimated = turn.budget.charge(usage, messages)
                response = {**response, "budget": {"charged_tokens": charged, "estimated": estimated,
                                                   "turn_tokens": turn.budget.tokens}}
                return asyncio.to_thread(
                    self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
                    latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=tokens,
                    model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))

            try:
                # aclosing: a guard failure or a timeout must close the HTTP stream right away
                async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout), \
                        aclosing(self.llm.stream(
                            messages, TOOL_SCHEMAS, reasoning_effort=turn.reasoning_effort)) as stream:
                    async for event in stream:
                        if isinstance(event, TextDelta):
                            content += event.text
                            for sentence in buffer.push(event.text):
                                if sentence.strip():
                                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
                                    blank, released = "", True
                                else:
                                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own
                        else:
                            completion = event
                if completion is None:
                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a completion", retryable=True)
                rest = buffer.flush()
                if rest.strip():
                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
            except _GuardFailed as failed:
                await log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems, "aborted": True})
                raise
            except (LLMError, TimeoutError) as exc:
                error = exc if isinstance(exc, LLMError) else LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True)
                await log_call({"content": content, "error": str(error)[:300], "attempt": attempt + 1})
                if released or not error.retryable or attempt == self.retries:
                    raise error from None
                await self._sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
                continue
            await log_call(completion.as_record(), completion.total_tokens, completion.usage)
            return completion
        raise LLMError("unreachable", retryable=False)  # pragma: no cover

    def _city_index(self) -> CityIndex:
        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when
        locations.db changes)."""
        net = self._networks.current()
        if self._index is None or self._index[0] != net.fingerprint.id:
            self._index = (net.fingerprint.id, CityIndex(net.cities))
        return self._index[1]
"""The four tools the LLM can call: schemas, argument validation, dispatch to the airline.

Arguments are names and ids only - never a distance or a price - so the LLM cannot pass a number
it made up. Results go back to the LLM as display values; errors are structured records too.

There is no booking tool. `Toolbox` keeps only the four bound methods it dispatches to, not the
`Airline` object, so nothing in this module can reach `Airline.book` (design P4, rule M04).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from typing import Any, Callable

MAX_ARG_CHARS = 200
MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS = 2000  # the whole JSON of one call
MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM = 20  # the card lists them all; `count` is always the full number


def _tool(name: str, description: str, properties: dict[str, str], required: list[str]) -> dict:
    return {
        "type": "function",
        "function": {
            "name": name,
            "description": description,
            "parameters": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {k: {"type": "string", "description": v} for k, v in properties.items()},
                "required": required,
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
    }


TOOL_SCHEMAS = [
    _tool("find_city",
          "Look up one city: whether Ocean Above flies there, and if not, the nearest cities that "
          "have service. Use it when the user asks about a single city.",
          {"name": "City name as the user wrote it."}, ["name"]),
    _tool("quote_route",
          "Find the cheapest route between two cities and create a quote (legs, transfer cities, "
          "distance, price). Also reports unknown, ambiguous or unserved cities, with the nearest "
          "served cities. Shows a route card to the user.",
          {"origin": "Departure city as the user wrote it.",
           "destination": "Arrival city as the user wrote it."},
          ["origin", "destination"]),
    _tool("request_booking",
          "Show the user a confirmation card for an existing quote. Call it when the user wants to "
          "book a quoted route. It does NOT book: the ticket is issued only when the user clicks "
          "Confirm booking on the card.",
          {"quote_id": "The quote_id from a quote_route result (starts with q_)."}, ["quote_id"]),
    _tool("list_my_tickets",
          "List the tickets the user has booked, with the count. All filters are optional.",
          {"city": "Only tickets whose origin, destination or a transfer is this city.",
           "ticket_id": "Only this ticket (starts with t_).",
           "booked_after": "ISO date or datetime (UTC); tickets booked at or after it.",
           "booked_before": "ISO date or datetime (UTC); tickets booked before it."},
          []),
]
STATUS_TEXT = {
    "find_city": "Looking up the city…",
    "quote_route": "Looking up routes…",
    "request_booking": "Preparing your confirmation…",
    "list_my_tickets": "Looking up your tickets…",
}
DEFAULT_STATUS = "Working on it…"
_SPECS = {t["function"]["name"]: t["function"]["parameters"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Outcome:
    """One executed (or refused) tool call."""

    name: str
    args: Any  # parsed arguments, or the raw string when they were not valid JSON
    code: str
    payload: dict  # the JSON the LLM gets: {"code": ..., display values, names, ids}
    cards: tuple[dict, ...] = ()
    error: str | None = None  # set for calls that did not run or crashed
    latency_ms: int = 0

    def for_llm(self) -> str:
        return json.dumps(self.payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def slim(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Drop the 30-decimal `distance` / `price` strings where a display value sits next to them:
    the LLM only ever sees display values."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: slim(v) for k, v in value.items()
                if not (k in ("distance", "price") and f"{k}_display" in value)}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [slim(v) for v in value]
    return value


def _payload(code: str, data: dict) -> dict:
    out = {"code": code, **slim(data)}
    if isinstance(out.get("tickets"), list) and len(out["tickets"]) > MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM:
        out["tickets"] = out["tickets"][:MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM]  # newest first
        out["tickets_shown"] = MAX_TICKETS_FOR_LLM
    if isinstance(out.get("legs"), list) and isinstance(out.get("transfers"), list):
        # counted here so the LLM never counts (FSR: self-reported counts go wrong)
        out["leg_count"] = len(out["legs"])
        out["transfer_count"] = len(out["transfers"])
    return out


def validate(name: str, args: Any) -> tuple[dict | None, str | None]:
    """(clean arguments, None) or (None, what is wrong)."""
    spec = _SPECS[name]
    if not isinstance(args, dict):
        return None, "arguments must be a JSON object"
    unknown = sorted(set(args) - set(spec["properties"]))
    if unknown:
        return None, f"unknown argument(s): {', '.join(unknown)}; allowed: {', '.join(spec['properties'])}"
    clean: dict[str, str] = {}
    for key in spec["properties"]:
        value = args.get(key)
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip() and key not in spec["required"]):
            continue
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return None, f"{key} must be a string"
        value = value.strip()
        if not value:
            return None, f"{key} must not be empty"
        if len(value) > MAX_ARG_CHARS:
            return None, f"{key} is too long"
        clean[key] = value
    missing = [k for k in spec["required"] if k not in clean]
    if missing:
        return None, f"missing argument(s): {', '.join(missing)}"
    return clean, None


class Toolbox:
    def __init__(self, airline: Any):
        find_city, quote_route = airline.find_city, airline.quote_route
        request_booking, list_tickets = airline.request_booking, airline.list_tickets
        self._run: dict[str, Callable[[str, str, dict], Any]] = {
            "find_city": lambda user, conv, a: find_city(a["name"]),
            "quote_route": lambda user, conv, a: quote_route(user, conv, a["origin"], a["destination"]),
            "request_booking": lambda user, conv, a: request_booking(user, conv, a["quote_id"]),
            "list_my_tickets": lambda user, conv, a: list_tickets(user, **a),
        }

    def run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, name: str, raw_arguments: str) -> Outcome:
        """Validate and execute one tool call. Never raises: every failure is an Outcome the LLM
        can read and correct."""
        started = time.monotonic()

        def refused(code: str, message: str, args: Any, **extra: Any) -> Outcome:
            return Outcome(name, args, code, {"code": code, "message": message, **extra},
                           error=message, latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))

        if name not in self._run:
            return refused("unknown_tool", f"there is no tool named {name!r}", raw_arguments,
                           available=sorted(self._run))
        if not isinstance(raw_arguments, str):
            raw_arguments = ""
        if len(raw_arguments) > MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS:
            return refused("invalid_arguments", "arguments are too long", raw_arguments[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS])
        try:
            args = json.loads(raw_arguments) if raw_arguments.strip() else {}
        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
            return refused("invalid_arguments", "arguments are not valid JSON", raw_arguments)
        clean, problem = validate(name, args)
        if clean is None:
            return refused("invalid_arguments", problem or "invalid arguments", args)
        try:
            result = self._run[name](user_id, conversation_id, clean)
        except Exception as exc:  # NetworkDataError (locations.db unreadable), NotFound, bugs
            failed = refused("tool_failed", "the tool could not run; flight data may be unavailable", clean)
            return replace(failed, error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:500])
        return Outcome(name, clean, result.code, _payload(result.code, result.data),
                       tuple(result.cards), latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))

"""LLM settings from the environment. The key is read here and nowhere else; it is never logged
and never part of a repr."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Mapping

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.deepseek.com"
# DeepSeek's flash model id on 2026-11-23 (GET /models: "deepseek-flash" = DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash).
DEFAULT_MODEL = "deepseek-flash"
REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
EFFORTS = ("none", "low", "high", "max")  # what a request may ask for


class LLMNotConfigured(Exception):
    """No API key in the environment or the env file."""


def read_env_file(path: str | Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """KEY=VALUE lines of a .env file (comments, blank lines and `export ` are skipped)."""
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError:
        return out
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.removeprefix("export ").split("=", 1)
        value = value.strip()
        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "'\"":
            value = value[1:-1]
        out[key.strip()] = value
    return out


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LLMConfig:
    api_key: str = field(repr=False)
    base_url: str = DEFAULT_BASE_URL
    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
    # Thinking level (DeepSeek: `thinking` + `reasoning_effort`, docs "Thinking Mode"):
    #   "low" | "high" | "max" -> {"thinking": {"type": "enabled"}, "reasoning_effort": <level>}
    #   "none"                 -> {"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}}
    #   "omit"                 -> neither field, for OpenAI-compatible servers that reject them
    reasoning_effort: str = "high"

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.reasoning_effort not in (*EFFORTS, "omit"):
            raise ValueError(f"LLM_REASONING_EFFORT must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)} or omit")

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> "LLMConfig":
        """`LLM_API_KEY` (fallback `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), `LLM_BASE_URL`, `LLM_MODEL`,
        `LLM_REASONING_EFFORT` (default high). Process environment first; then the file named by `OCEAN_ENV_FILE`
        (default: `.env` in the repository root), so a worktree can point at the main checkout."""
        env = os.environ if env is None else env
        file_values = read_env_file(env.get("OCEAN_ENV_FILE") or REPO_ROOT / ".env")

        def get(name: str) -> str:
            return (env.get(name) or file_values.get(name) or "").strip()

        key = get("LLM_API_KEY") or get("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
        if not key:
            raise LLMNotConfigured("set LLM_API_KEY (or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), or OCEAN_ENV_FILE")
        return cls(
            api_key=key,
            base_url=(get("LLM_BASE_URL") or DEFAULT_BASE_URL).rstrip("/"),
            model=get("LLM_MODEL") or DEFAULT_MODEL,
            reasoning_effort=(get("LLM_REASONING_EFFORT") or "high").lower(),
        )

"""Daily usage limits (L2, contract v1.2): messages per user and the site's LLM token budget.

Checked before the message stream starts. The count and the reservation are one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`
transaction (`Store.reserve_message`), so two messages racing for the last slot cannot both pass.
A refused message stores nothing. Booking, tickets and history are never limited.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from ..store import Store, day_start, iso
from .errors import ApiError
from .settings import Settings


def resets_at(now: datetime) -> str:
    """Next 00:00 UTC (wire form)."""
    return iso(day_start(now) + timedelta(days=1))


def usage_view(store: Store, settings: Settings, user_id: str) -> dict:
    """The contract's `Usage` for /api/me."""
    return {"messages_today": store.messages_today(user_id), "daily_limit": settings.daily_messages_per_user,
            "resets_at": resets_at(store.clock())}


def reserve_message(store: Store, settings: Settings, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> str:
    """Take one of today's message slots or raise 429 `rate_limited` (scope user / site).
    Returns the reservation id (to release it if the message is then refused as invalid)."""
    reservation, scope = store.reserve_message(
        user_id, conversation_id, daily_limit=settings.daily_messages_per_user,
        token_budget=settings.daily_token_budget)
    if reservation is not None:
        return reservation
    when = resets_at(store.clock())
    if scope == "user":
        message = (f"You have used today's {settings.daily_messages_per_user} messages. "
                   "The limit resets at 00:00 UTC.")
    else:
        message = ("The assistant has reached today's usage budget for this site. "
                   "It resets at 00:00 UTC. Your bookings and tickets are still available.")
    raise ApiError(429, "rate_limited", message, extra={"scope": scope, "resets_at": when})

        return con

            con.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

    def read(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        """A connection for reads; several statements see one snapshot."""
        con = self._connect()
        try:
            con.execute("BEGIN")
            try:
                yield con
            finally:
                con.execute("ROLLBACK")
        finally:
            con.close()

    @contextmanager
    def write(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        """One `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction: commit on normal exit, roll back on any exception."""
        con = self._connect()
        try:
            con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
            try:
                yield con
            except BaseException:
                if con.in_transaction:  # sqlite rolls back by itself on some errors (disk full)
                    con.execute("ROLLBACK")
                raise
            con.execute("COMMIT")

            con.close()

"""One lock per conversation, shared by chat turns and the booking endpoint (design §4.6, B7).

In-process only: the API runs as a single uvicorn worker. The database does not rely on this lock
for B5/B7 (those hold through `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and `tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`); the lock keeps a
booking click and a running chat turn of the same conversation from interleaving.

The lock is NOT reentrant. `Airline.book` takes it itself; everything else in `Airline` expects
the caller (the chat turn) to hold it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import AsyncIterator, Iterator


class ConversationBusy(Exception):
    """The conversation lock was not obtained within the timeout."""


class ConversationLocks:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._mutex = threading.Lock()
        self._entries: dict[str, list] = {}  # conversation id -> [lock, holders + waiters]

    def _checkout(self, conversation_id: str) -> threading.Lock:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.setdefault(conversation_id, [threading.Lock(), 0])
            entry[1] += 1
            return entry[0]

    def _checkin(self, conversation_id: str) -> None:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries[conversation_id]
            entry[1] -= 1
            if entry[1] == 0:
                del self._entries[conversation_id]

    @contextmanager
    def hold(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Blocking form, for sync code (threadpool endpoints). Never call it on the event loop:
        use `hold_async` there."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            if not lock.acquire(timeout=-1 if timeout is None else timeout):
                raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def hold_async(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None,
                         poll: float = 0.01) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        """Async form of the same lock: waits without blocking the event loop, safe to cancel
        while waiting, and may be held across awaits (a whole streamed turn)."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            deadline = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout
            while not lock.acquire(blocking=False):
                if deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
                await asyncio.sleep(poll)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    def locked(self, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.get(conversation_id)
            return entry is not None and entry[0].locked()

## SSE stream (`POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages`)

`Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Each event: `event: <name>\ndata: <json>\n\n`.

| event | data | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `user_message` | `Message` | the stored user message, first event |
| `status` | `{"text":"Looking up routes…"}` | progress, replaceable |
| `card` | `{"card": Card}` | push immediately; state.bookable is false until `done` |
| `delta` | `{"text":"…"}` | append; already validated text (one sentence or more) |
| `replace` | `{"text":"…"}` | replace the whole assistant text so far |
| `ping` | `{}` | heartbeat every 15 s; ignore |
| `done` | `{"message": Message}` | final assistant message incl. cards with current states |
| `error` | `{"code","message"}` | stream ends; the user message is kept, **except** `conversation_busy` (another turn holds the conversation; sent before `user_message`, nothing stored — keep the input box text and retry) |

Example: `contract/fixtures/sse_quote_turn.txt`.

- 失败：流式下已推出的句子无法撤回，所以**不重写**，直接 `replace` 成代码模板回复（模板只用记录拼句子）。
  失败原因落库，计入评测指标。
- 已知漏洞：文字写出的数（「两千多公里」「three tickets」）看不出来 → prompt 禁止 + 评测检查 + 写入已知限制。
- 03 开工第一步：用约 20 个用例在 DeepSeek flash 上实测校验通过率和回退率，再定 prompt；如回退率过高，改为
  「文字不写任何数字，事实全在卡片」。

- **实现细化（T3，2026-11-23）**：
  - 可见记录 = 上下文里全部工具结果 + 出票事件（不只本轮）；工具只回显 LLM 自己参数的内容（query、filter、错误信息）
    不算记录；
  - 城市名：用户在本会话任何一条消息里提到的库内城市都可出现；prompt 要求城市名一律用记录里的英文原名
    （回复是中文也一样）；被翻译成其他文字的城市名 guard 查不到，写入已知限制；
  - 数字带单位核对（`$` ↔ 价格、`km` ↔ 距离；英里、小时、百分比等一律不放行）；计数只来自代码给的
    `count` / `leg_count` / `transfer_count`；有序列表序号只认 1、2、3… 连续序列；
  - **出票声明规则**：本轮记录里没有用户点击出票或非空的查票结果时，「已出票 / booked / confirmed」类说法回退模板；
    `request_booking` 成功的轮次由代码在末尾追加固定的点击提示；
  - LLM 不可用且本轮没有任何产出 → SSE `error`，只保留用户消息；`finish_reason` 不是 `stop` → 模板；
  - 整轮总时限 90 s、会话锁等待 10 s（超时 `conversation_busy`，消息不保存）；内联 `<think>` 块剥离；
    给 LLM 的高精度值去掉，只给显示值。
  - 真模型实测（deepseek-flash，effort high，31 场景 / 50 轮）：50/50 原样放行，0 回退，0 虚假出票声明；费用约 $0.016。

### 4.6 失败处理
| 情况 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| LLM 超时 / 5xx | 指数退避重试 2 次 → 回复「服务暂时不可用」，用户消息保留，可重发 |
| 工具参数不合法 | 结构化错误回给 LLM，计入工具调用成功率的失败 |
| 超过 MAX_STEPS | 模板回复，附本轮已产生的记录 |
| 用户在回复完成前又发消息 / 点按钮 | 同会话串行（每会话一把锁，聊天和出票接口共用）；uvicorn 单 worker |
| 超出限额 | 明确提示（每用户每日消息上限、全站每日预算） |
| 本轮工具调用或 token 超出预算 | 超出的工具调用不执行并回结构化拒绝；需要结束时模板回复（`tool_budget` / `token_budget`），见 §4.8 |

### 4.7 流式输出
- 传输：`POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages` 返回 SSE（`text/event-stream`），前端用 fetch 逐段读取。
- 事件：
  | 事件 | 内容 | 时机 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `status` | 「正在查询航线…」等进度 | 每次工具调用前 |

|---|---|
| LLM 超时 / 5xx | 指数退避重试 2 次 → 回复「服务暂时不可用」，用户消息保留，可重发 |

| 超过 MAX_STEPS | 模板回复，附本轮已产生的记录 |

"""Scaffolding for the agent tests: a scripted fake LLM and helpers to run a turn and to check
the event stream against the contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.agent import Agent, Completion, Event, TextDelta

from .airline_helpers import assert_card, assert_message


class Call:
    """A tool call in a script. `raw` replaces the JSON arguments (to send broken ones)."""

    def __init__(self, tool: str, /, raw: str | None = None, **args: Any):
        self.name = tool
        self.arguments = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(args)


class Think:
    """Reasoning text of a step (thinking mode): stored with the call, never a TextDelta."""

    def __init__(self, text: str):
        self.text = text


class Finish:
    """Override the finish_reason of a step (e.g. "length")."""

    def __init__(self, reason: str):
        self.reason = reason


class Wait:
    """Pause the scripted stream: `await gate.wait()` (asyncio.Event) or sleep `seconds`."""

    def __init__(self, gate: asyncio.Event | None = None, seconds: float = 0.0):
        self.gate, self.seconds = gate, seconds


class FakeLLM:
    """Plays one scripted step per LLM call. A step is a list of: str (a text chunk), Call,
    Wait, or an Exception (raised at that point); or an Exception (the call fails at once); or a
    function `messages -> step` for steps that need a value from an earlier tool result. When
    the script is used up, every further call gets `default` (if given)."""

    model = "fake-llm"

    def __init__(self, *steps: Any, default: Any = None):
        self.steps = list(steps)
        self.default = default
        self.requests: list[list[dict]] = []  # the messages of every call (deep copies)
        self.tools_seen: list[list[str]] = []
        self.efforts: list[str | None] = []  # the per-request reasoning_effort of every call

    async def stream(self, messages, tools, *, reasoning_effort=None):
        self.requests.append(json.loads(json.dumps(messages)))
        self.efforts.append(reasoning_effort)
        self.tools_seen.append([t["function"]["name"] for t in tools])
        if self.steps:
            step = self.steps.pop(0)
        elif self.default is not None:
            step = self.default
        else:
            raise AssertionError("FakeLLM: the script has no step for this call")
        if callable(step):
            step = step(messages)
        if isinstance(step, Exception):
            raise step
        content, calls, reasoning, finish = "", [], "", None
        for item in step:
            if isinstance(item, Exception):
                raise item
            if isinstance(item, Wait):
                if item.gate is not None:
                    await item.gate.wait()
                else:
                    await asyncio.sleep(item.seconds)
            elif isinstance(item, Finish):
                finish = item.reason
            elif isinstance(item, Think):
                reasoning += item.text
            elif isinstance(item, Call):
                calls.append({"id": f"call_{len(self.requests)}_{len(calls)}", "name": item.name,
                              "arguments": item.arguments})
            else:
                content += item
                yield TextDelta(item)
        yield Completion(content, calls, finish or ("tool_calls" if calls else "stop"),
                         {"prompt_tokens": 100, "completion_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 110}, reasoning)

    """The decoded tool results in a context, oldest first."""
    return [json.loads(m["content"]) for m in messages if m["role"] == "tool"]


def last_quote_id(messages: list[dict]) -> str:
    return [r["quote_id"] for r in tool_results(messages) if "quote_id" in r][-1]

    async def go():
        events = [e async for e in agent.stream_turn(user, conv, text)]
        await agent.wait_idle()
        return events

    return asyncio.run(go())

    return [e.name for e in events]

    """What the client shows at the end, built the way a client builds it: deltas appended,
    `replace` replacing everything so far."""
    text = ""
    for e in events:
        if e.name == "delta":
            text += e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "replace":
            text = e.data["text"]
    return text

    async def go():

def test_a_booking_click_waits_for_the_running_turn(world):
    """Chat turn and booking endpoint share the conversation lock (design §4.6, B7)."""
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented("Guangzhou", "Lima")

    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, _ = make(world, [Wait(gate), "One moment."])
        stream = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "hello")
        await stream.__anext__()  # the turn holds the lock now
        with pytest.raises(BookingError) as busy:
            await world.airline.book_async(world.alice, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=0.05)
        assert busy.value.code == "conversation_busy"
        assert world.ticket_count() == 0
        result = {}
        clicker = threading.Thread(
            target=lambda: result.update(world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=None)))
        clicker.start()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        assert clicker.is_alive()  # blocked behind the turn
        gate.set()
        rest = [e async for e in stream]
        await asyncio.to_thread(clicker.join, 5)
        return rest, result

    rest, result = asyncio.run(go())
    assert names(rest) == ["delta", "done"] and result["ticket"]["quote_id"] == quote_id
    assert [m["role"] for m in stored(world)] == ["assistant", "user", "assistant", "system"]


def test_two_turns_of_one_conversation_run_one_after_the_other(world):
    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, llm = make(world, [Wait(gate), "First."], ["Second."])
        a = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "one")
        first = await a.__anext__()

    async def go():

    assert names(events)[0] == "user_message" and names(events)[-2:] == ["delta", "done"]
    assert names(events).count("ping") >= 2 and message["text"] == "Where to?"


def test_the_turn_finishes_and_is_stored_when_the_client_disconnects(world):
    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, _ = make(world, [Wait(gate), QUOTE], good_reply)
        stream = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, ASK)
        first = await stream.__anext__()
        await stream.aclose()  # the browser went away after the first event
        assert first.name == "user_message" and [m["role"] for m in stored(world)] == ["user"]
        gate.set()
        await agent.wait_idle()

    asyncio.run(go())
    rows = stored(world)
    assert [m["role"] for m in rows] == ["user", "assistant"]
    quote_id = rows[1]["cards"][0]["id"]
    assert world.status(quote_id) == "presented"
    # reloading the conversation shows the card, bookable
    card = world.airline.messages(world.alice, world.conv)[1]["cards"][0]
    assert card["state"]["bookable"] is True


def test_a_booking_click_waits_for_the_running_turn(world):
    """Chat turn and booking endpoint share the conversation lock (design §4.6, B7)."""
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented("Guangzhou", "Lima")

    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, _ = make(world, [Wait(gate), "One moment."])
        stream = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "hello")
        await stream.__anext__()  # the turn holds the lock now
        with pytest.raises(BookingError) as busy:
            await world.airline.book_async(world.alice, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=0.05)
        assert busy.value.code == "conversation_busy"
        assert world.ticket_count() == 0
        result = {}
        clicker = threading.Thread(
            target=lambda: result.update(world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=None)))
        clicker.start()
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        assert clicker.is_alive()  # blocked behind the turn
        gate.set()
        rest = [e async for e in stream]
        await asyncio.to_thread(clicker.join, 5)
        return rest, result

    rest, result = asyncio.run(go())
    assert names(rest) == ["delta", "done"] and result["ticket"]["quote_id"] == quote_id
    assert [m["role"] for m in stored(world)] == ["assistant", "user", "assistant", "system"]

    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, llm = make(world, [Wait(gate), "First."], ["Second."])
        a = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "one")
        first = await a.__anext__()
        b = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "two")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        assert [m["text"] for m in stored(world)] == ["one"]  # "two" is not even stored yet

        return [first] + [e async for e in a], [e async for e in b]

    assert final_text(a) == "First." and final_text(b) == "Second."

    async def go():
        gate = asyncio.Event()
        agent, _ = make(world, [Wait(gate), "First."], lock_timeout=0.05)
        a = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "one")

        b = [e async for e in agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "two")]

"""The booking assistant's agent loop (design §4): our own code over a plain OpenAI-compatible
HTTP client. It understands the request, calls the airline's tools and phrases what they
returned; it never computes a route or a price and it has no way to book."""
from .config import LLMConfig, LLMNotConfigured
from .guard import CityIndex, ReplyGuard
from .llm import LLM, Completion, LLMError, OpenAIChatClient, TextDelta
from .loop import MAX_STEPS, Agent, Event
from .sse import encode, encode_stream
from .templates import fallback_reply
from .tools import TOOL_SCHEMAS, Toolbox

__all__ = ["LLM", "MAX_STEPS", "TOOL_SCHEMAS", "Agent", "CityIndex", "Completion", "Event",
           "LLMConfig", "LLMError", "LLMNotConfigured", "OpenAIChatClient", "ReplyGuard",
           "TextDelta", "Toolbox", "encode", "encode_stream", "fallback_reply"]
"""Wire form of the events: `event: <name>\\ndata: <json>\\n\\n` (docs/api/contract.md)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import AsyncIterator

from .loop import Event

MEDIA_TYPE = "text/event-stream"
# no proxy buffering, no caching: each event must reach the browser when it is written
HEADERS = {"Cache-Control": "no-cache, no-transform", "X-Accel-Buffering": "no"}


def encode(event: Event) -> str:
    data = json.dumps(event.data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    return f"event: {event.name}\ndata: {data}\n\n"


async def encode_stream(events: AsyncIterator[Event]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """For `StreamingResponse(encode_stream(agent.stream_turn(...)), media_type=MEDIA_TYPE)`."""
    async for event in events:
        yield encode(event)

    store = Store(tmp_path / "app.db", operation_timeout=0.1)
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "u", "U")["id"]
    endless = "WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n) SELECT count(*) FROM n"
    for ctx in (store.write, store.read):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with pytest.raises(StoreUnavailable, match="interrupted"):
            with ctx() as con:
                if ctx == store.write:
                    con.execute("UPDATE users SET display_name = 'changed' WHERE id = ?", (user,))
                con.execute(endless).fetchone()

    assert store.get_user(user)["display_name"] == "U"  # rolled back

    with store.write() as con:

        b = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, convs[1], "two")

def test_a_turn_cut_short_waits_for_its_tool_thread_before_storing_and_unlocking(world):
    """The turn's time limit passes while a tool thread runs. The thread is not killed; the turn
    keeps the conversation lock and its slot until the thread ended, then stores the template
    reply. A booking click meanwhile gets conversation_busy."""
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented()
    block, entered = threading.Event(), threading.Event()
    find_city = world.airline.find_city

    def slow_find_city(name):
        entered.set()
        block.wait(5)
        return find_city(name)

    world.airline.find_city = slow_find_city

    async def go():
        agent = Agent(world.airline, FakeLLM([Call("find_city", name="A")], default=["Done."]),
                      turn_timeout=0.2, concurrency=TurnConcurrency(1, 0))
        stream = agent.stream_turn(world.alice, world.conv, "where is A")
        await asyncio.to_thread(entered.wait, 5)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.4)  # well past the 0.2 s limit
        assert world.airline.locks.locked(world.conv) and agent.slots.active == 1
        assert stored_texts(world, world.conv)[-1] == "where is A"  # no reply stored yet
        with pytest.raises(BookingError) as busy:
            await world.airline.book_async(world.alice, quote_id, nonce, lock_timeout=0.05)
        assert busy.value.code == "conversation_busy"
        block.set()
        events = [e async for e in stream]
        await agent.wait_idle()
        return events, agent

    events, agent = asyncio.run(go())
    assert names(events)[-2:] == ["replace", "done"]
    rows = world.store.list_messages(world.alice, world.conv)
    assert rows[-1]["guard_problems"] == [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": "0.2"}]
    # the thread's work was finished and logged before the reply; the lock and slot are free
    calls = world.store.list_tool_calls(world.alice, rows[-2]["id"])
    assert calls == [] or calls[0]["name"] == "find_city"
    assert not world.airline.locks.locked(world.conv) and agent.slots.active == 0
    # the booking path is unaffected: the same click books now
    assert world.airline.book(world.alice, quote_id, nonce)["ticket"]["quote_id"] == quote_id

def test_threads_tracks_a_cancelled_call_until_it_ends():
    async def go():
        threads, release = Threads(), threading.Event()
        task = asyncio.create_task(threads.run(release.wait, 5))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        task.cancel()
        with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        assert threads.running == 1
        assert await threads.drain(0.05) is False
        release.set()
